name: Devops K8S Valero Backup

mission.primary_objective: Implement reliable Velero backup and disaster recovery solutions for Kubernetes clusters with S3/Minio storage, scheduled snapshots, and tested restore procedures
mission.context: You are a specialist. Your goal is to apply this expertise in context.
mission.target_outcome: Production-ready, correct outcomes aligned with the objective.
mission.scope: Expert in Kubernetes backup strategies using Velero, including volume snapshots, backup schedules, cross-cluster restores, and disaster recovery planning.

role: LegioX truth lens — Devops K8S Valero Backup
core_expertise: Implement reliable Velero backup and disaster recovery solutions for Kubernetes clusters with S3/Minio storage, scheduled snapshots, and tested restore procedures

meta.title: K8s/K3s Daily Incremental PVC Backup to Ubuntu 24 Host Directory
meta.strategy: Velero 1.14+ with Kopia uploader + MinIO as local S3-compatible backend mounted on Ubuntu host dir
meta.rationale: Velero 1.14+ supports CSI snapshot → Kopia offsite upload pipeline. Kopia replaces restic with native incremental/deduplication. MinIO provides S3 API over a local hostpath, eliminating cloud dependency. Works on both k8s and k3s local-path storage classes without RWX requirement.
meta.topology: Ubuntu24 host runs MinIO container → exposes S3 endpoint → Velero node-agent (DaemonSet) uses Kopia to push PVC data to MinIO bucket → data lands in designated host dir
meta.diff_mechanism: Kopia content-addressable chunking provides automatic block-level deduplication and incremental-forever semantics per backup cycle

phase_0_host_prerequisites.description: Prepare Ubuntu 24 host before touching the cluster

1_create_backup_dir.note: This is the designated host dir. Adjust path as needed.

2_install_docker.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io && systemctl enable --now docker

3_deploy_minio.cmd: docker run -d --name minio --restart=always -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -v /opt/k8s-backups/minio-data:/data -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=velero -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME_32CHARS quay.io/minio/minio server /data --console-address ':9001'
3_deploy_minio.security_note: Replace MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD with a strong random value. TLS termination via nginx recommended for production.

4_create_velero_bucket.cmd: docker run --rm --network host -e MC_HOST_local=http://velero:CHANGE_ME_32CHARS@localhost:9000 quay.io/minio/mc mb local/velero-backups

phase_1_cluster_tooling.description: Install CLI tools on the machine that has kubeconfig access

1_install_velero_cli.cmd: VELERO_VERSION=v1.14.1 && curl -sSL https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/releases/download/${VELERO_VERSION}/velero-${VELERO_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp && mv /tmp/velero-${VELERO_VERSION}-linux-amd64/velero /usr/local/bin/velero && velero version --client-only

2_add_velero_helm_repo.cmd: helm repo add vmware-tanzu https://vmware-tanzu.github.io/helm-charts && helm repo update

phase_2_velero_credentials.description: Create MinIO credentials secret consumed by Velero

1_create_credentials_file.note: Match the MinIO root credentials set in phase_0

2_create_namespace.cmd: kubectl create namespace velero --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

3_create_k8s_secret.cmd: kubectl create secret generic velero-s3-credentials --namespace velero --from-file=cloud=/tmp/velero-credentials --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

phase_3_velero_install.description: Install Velero via Helm with Kopia uploader targeting local MinIO

content.yaml:
initContainers:
  - name: velero-plugin-for-aws
    image: velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.10.0
    volumeMounts:
      - mountPath: /target
        name: plugins

configuration:
  uploaderType: kopia
  backupStorageLocation:
    - name: default
      provider: aws
      bucket: velero-backups
      default: true
      config:
        region: minio
        s3ForcePathStyle: "true"
        s3Url: "http://UBUNTU_HOST_IP:9000"
        publicUrl: "http://UBUNTU_HOST_IP:9000"
  volumeSnapshotLocation:
    - name: default
      provider: aws
      config:
        region: minio

credentials:
  existingSecret: velero-s3-credentials

snapshotsEnabled: false

deployNodeAgent: true

nodeAgent:
  podVolumePath: /var/lib/kubelet/pods
  tolerations:
    - operator: Exists

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi

2_helm_install.cmd: sed -i 's/UBUNTU_HOST_IP/REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_IP/g' /tmp/velero-values.yaml && helm install velero vmware-tanzu/velero --namespace velero -f /tmp/velero-values.yaml --wait
2_helm_install.note: Replace REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_IP with the Ubuntu host's LAN IP reachable from cluster nodes

3_k3s_node_agent_patch.note: k3s uses a non-standard kubelet pods path; this patch is mandatory for PVC discovery

4_verify_velero.cmd: velero backup-location get && kubectl -n velero get pods

phase_4_default_volume_backup_opt_in.description: Configure all PVCs to be backed up by default without per-pod annotations

1_patch_velero_deployment.note: Opts all pod volumes into Kopia FSB automatically. Override per-namespace with annotation backup.velero.io/backup-volumes-excludes if needed.

phase_5_daily_schedule.description: Create Velero Schedule CRD for nightly incremental backup of all namespaces

1_create_schedule.schedule_note: Runs at 02:00 UTC daily. TTL 168h = 7-day retention window. Adjust --exclude-namespaces to taste.
1_create_schedule.incremental_note: Kopia deduplicates across backup runs; each backup stores only changed blocks against the shared content repository

2_verify_schedule.cmd: velero schedule get && velero schedule describe daily-full

3_trigger_manual_test.cmd: velero backup create test-run-01 --from-schedule daily-full --wait && velero backup describe test-run-01 --details

phase_6_verify_host_dir.description: Confirm backup data materialised on Ubuntu host filesystem

2_check_bucket_via_cli.cmd: docker run --rm --network host -e MC_HOST_local=http://velero:CHANGE_ME_32CHARS@localhost:9000 quay.io/minio/mc ls --recursive local/velero-backups | tail -30

3_check_kopia_repo_contents.cmd: kubectl -n velero exec -it deploy/velero -- /velero backup describe test-run-01 --details 2>&1 | grep -E 'Phase|Kopia|Volume|Error'

phase_7_restore_procedure.description: Reference restore commands — run only during actual recovery

4_restore_to_new_cluster.note: On new cluster: repeat phases 0-3 pointing to the same MinIO host, then run restore commands above. Velero discovers existing backup repository automatically.

1_daily_cron_health_check_on_host.cmd: echo '30 3 * * * root kubectl -n velero get backups --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp -o jsonpath="{.items[-1].status.phase}" | grep -v Completed && echo BACKUP_FAILED | mail -s "Velero alert" ops@yourdomain' >> /etc/cron.d/velero-monitor
1_daily_cron_health_check_on_host.note: Fires alert if latest backup is not Completed. Requires mailutils on host.

2_minio_disk_watch.cmd: echo '0 6 * * * root df -h /opt/k8s-backups/minio-data | awk NR==2{if($5+0>85) print "MINIO disk > 85%: "$5}' >> /etc/cron.d/velero-monitor

known_limitations.consistency: Kopia FSB is not application-quiesced. For stateful DBs (Postgres, MySQL) add velero pre-backup exec hooks to flush/checkpoint before snapshot.
known_limitations.hostpath_volumes: hostPath type PVCs are not backed up by Velero/Kopia. Use emptyDir with a pre-hook dump pattern as described in the Reddit thread.
known_limitations.k3s_local_path: k3s local-path-provisioner PVCs are supported via Kopia FSB only — no CSI snapshot driver present by default.
known_limitations.minio_ha: Single MinIO instance is a SPOF. For production resilience, add MinIO replication to a secondary path or NAS mount.
known_limitations.secret_backup: Kubernetes Secrets are backed up as plaintext inside the Velero tarball. Ensure MinIO data dir has restricted permissions and consider enabling Velero's encryption at rest via BackupStorageLocation spec.objectStorage.caCert and KMS integration.
